brief.audience: Independent operators and small teams looking for ongoing bookkeeping, catch-up work, or payroll coordination.
brief.primaryAction: Start a consultation through an explicitly unconfigured inquiry form.
brief.content: Plain-scope bookkeeping marketing copy with package names but no invented prices, testimonials, credentials, statistics, or regulated advice.
brief.imagery: Original editorial still life and studio photography in ink, ivory, ochre, walnut, and brass; each homepage role uses a distinct scene.

directions.thesis: A calm bookkeeping practice expressed through a strict editorial grid, dark ink, warm paper, and a restrained ochre signal color.

fingerprint.header: Ivory shared header with graphic woven-ledger logo and compact native menu.
fingerprint.hero: Full photographic worktable with an anchored ink reading panel and a three-line headline.
fingerprint.textAnchor: Large geometric headings paired with compact uppercase labels and readable Work Sans body copy.
fingerprint.inventory: Ruled service records, a tactile workbench story, and a three-part monthly rhythm.
fingerprint.cta: Dark photographic studio panel with one concise consultation action.
fingerprint.footer: Compact ink footer with light graphic logo, wrapping links, and quiet demo disclosure.

directions.comparison: Most aligned with the requested precision-editorial identity and bookkeeping subject; avoids advisory-style case studies and generic card grids.

sections.composition: full image with anchored text panel

single image-copy pairing followed by dark three-part process

directions.thesis: A more austere monochrome ledger system built from strong rules, narrow labels, and document-like reading rhythm.
directions.comparison: More document-led and less welcoming; retained as a distinct direction record only.

directions.thesis: A softer maker-studio interpretation that centers tactile work, warm photography, and conversational copy.
directions.comparison: Warmer and more lifestyle-led; less precise than the selected implementation direction.
